# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**Best overall: JBL Charge 6** (about $130-$150)
- It has an IP68 rating, 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), and strong, clear sound. It also works as a power bank for your phone. [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) named it best overall and listed it at $129.99 at Walmart and $149.95 at Amazon. [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) also picked it first and had it at $150.
- It has no speakerphone function, and it's chunkier than the Flip.

**Other picks by need**
- **Loud pool party: JBL Boombox 4.** [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) ranks it the best waterproof speaker it tested. It floats, handles long immersion, and lasts over 40 hours. It sounds muffled if you're off to the side or behind it. It's big and pricey.
- **Even sound all around the pool: Ultimate Ears Epicboom.** It's IP67, floats, and has 360-degree sound with about 15 hours of battery. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) picked it best overall, and RTINGS named it best mid-range.
- **Budget: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4.** It's about the size of a softball, IP67, and floats. Battery is around 14 hours. [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) listed it at $65-$80.
- **Easy to pack: JBL Grip** (about $100). It's can-sized, IP68, and under a pound, with 12 hours of battery. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/) chose it as best overall for the beach. The mesh body can collect dust.
- **Cheapest: JBL Go 5** (about $40). It's IP67 and pocket-sized, but battery is only up to 8 hours. [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- **Soundcore Boom 3i** ($129.99). It's IP68, floats upright, resists saltwater, and has 16 hours of battery. [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-3i) (an affiliate link). Code AFSC20 reportedly brings it to $104. The source for this is the retailer-affiliated [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speaker-for-pool-or-beach-2026-reviews-ip67-battery-so), so I'd confirm the price at checkout.

**Buying links:** The search results gave me direct purchase links only for the Soundcore models. For the others, the review pages I've linked list current Amazon, Walmart, and Best Buy prices. Prices change, so check them before you buy.

**Care tips**
- Look for IP67 or IP68. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) says IP67 is the level that survives a pool party or beach trip.
- These ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) recommends rinsing with fresh water after use, if your manual allows it.
- Keep the charging port closed. Let the speaker dry fully before you charge it.
- At the beach, set it on a towel rather than in the sand.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want something pocketable or party-loud, I can narrow it to one.
